jobs.occupation: Early Childhood Educator at Kindergarten (Erzieher/in)
jobs.description:

Another daycare center will open in Bad Friedrichshall at the beginning of 2026. We care for children between the ages of 0 and 6 years in an open and partially immersive concept. Our facilities offer well-equipped functional rooms and outdoor play areas. The pedagogical focus is on bilingualism, music and STEM - the children always remain at the centre of our needs-oriented work and are involved in the day-to-day life of the nursery.

The company nurseries are part of the Phorms Education SE network of bilingual schools and nurseries, that has been enriching the educational landscape in Germany since 2006.

Early Childhood Educator

(in part-time or full-time)

Our Benefits

- An attractive salary with additional benefits (e.g. company pension scheme, monthly public transport ticket and free, freshly prepared lunch that changes daily)
- A relocation allowance and all paperwork completed and prepared for residency and work permits
- Continuing professional development opportunities
- Open concept with individual support for each child
- Innovative educational concepts and state of the art educational resources
- Short-term provision of employee housing at current market prices for a relaxed arrival

Your Responsibilities  

- Holistic support of our children in the cognitive, emotional, and creative areas
- Preparation and follow-up as well as implementation of parent meetings
- Regular observation of the holistic development and abilities of kindergarten children

Your Profile

- Certified training as an early childhood educator, a degree in education or comparable education that enables you to work as a specialist or supplementary staff member by the respective local authorities
- Identify with our pedagogical concept and are motivated to creatively implement it collaboratively as a team
- Motivated to co-create new pedagogical methodologies to continuously develop with the organisation
- Interest in working in a bilingual and international atmosphere
- Motivated and committed to working as part of a team
- Fluent English skills and German language skills at least level B2

jobs.occupation: Engineering Underwriter - Process Industries and new Technologies (m/f/d)* (Underwriter (Versicherung))
jobs.description:
Go beyond and create global impact: At Munich Re, we're proud to be one of the world's leading providers of reinsurance, primary insurance, and insurance-related risk solutions. Our group is made up of the reinsurance and ERGO business segments, along with our asset management company, MEAG. We operate globally and are active in all lines of the insurance business.
Since our founding in 1880, we've built a reputation for unrivalled risk-related expertise and a solid financial foundation. We use our strengths to support our clients' business goals and drive technological progress. We're also at the forefront of developing coverage for emerging risks, from rocket launches and renewable energy to cyber threats and artificial intelligence.
With around 44,000 people worldwide, our group's corporate culture is defined by performance, mutual respect, and trust. All this makes us an attractive employer providing global career development opportunities and prospects.
Global investment in industrial plants and infrastructure is being driven by evolving technologies, resilient supply chains, the energy transition and growing demand for critical resources. Munich Re F&C provides tailored insurance solutions for complex international construction projects, including oil, gas, chemicals and petrochemicals, mining and mineral processing, battery and semiconductor manufacturing, and emerging energy technologies such as green hydrogen, carbon capture and eSAF. As part of our Construction team, you will combine engineering expertise with commercial decision-making. We welcome applicants from insurance, industry, project development, EPC contracting and risk engineering. Prior underwriting experience is not essential if you bring relevant technical or contract expertise, sound judgement and a willingness to learn the insurance business.
Your Job

- Assess and underwrite complex international construction and industrial projects in line with Munich Re's strategy, risk appetite and delegated authority.
- Analyse technical, contractual and commercial information, identify key risk drivers and uncertainties, and document the decision process.
- Develop tailored insurance solutions that balance client needs, risk quality and sustainable profitability.
- Identify attractive business opportunities and contribute to profitable growth, portfolio quality, and diversification.
- Build trusted relationships with brokers, insureds and project stakeholders, and represent Munich Re at client meetings, project presentations and market events.
- Participate in or lead site surveys and translate findings into reports.
- Collaborate with colleagues and specialist experts, support the global Munich Re organisation and contribute to underwriting methods, tools and knowledge sharing.

Your Profile

- A university degree in engineering, natural sciences or other relevant technical disciplines, or a recognised insurance qualification with a strong interest in technical risks.
- Professional experience in process-driven industries, equipment manufacturing or another relevant technical environment, or experience in construction project insurance.
- The ability to understand complex industrial processes, project structures, and to derive clear conclusions from complex or incomplete information.
- The ability to familiarize yourself quickly with new topics, work independently, take ownership and make well-reasoned decisions.
- Strong communication, negotiation and stakeholder-management skills, combined with a constructive and solution-oriented approach.
- The ability to analyse technical and contractual documents and the motivation to develop expertise in insurance contracts and policy wordings.
- Curiosity about industrial sectors and emerging technologies, combined with an international and collaborative mindset and the ability to work effectively across cultures and functions.
- Fluent written and spoken English is required for working in an international business environment. German, Spanish or other relevant language skills are an advantage.
- Willingness to travel internationally.

Application Instructions
Please apply through our online portal and upload your CV, as well as your academic reference letters, including school certificates, graduation certificates and transcripts of record for any degrees. If applicable, please also submit reference letters from any previous employers or certificates from any other qualifications you may have. We recommend writing a cover letter to tell us more about why the position and Munich Re is of interest to you.
About us
As the world's leading reinsurance company with more than 16,000 employees at over 50 locations, Munich Re introduces a paradigm shift in the way you think about insurance. By turning uncertainty into a manageable risk we enable fundamental change. Join us working on topics today that will concern society tomorrow, whether that be climate change, major construction projects, medical risk assessment or even space travel.
Together we embrace a culture where multiskilled teams dare to think big. We create the new and the different for our clients and cultivate innovation.
Sounds like you? Push boundaries with us and be part of Munich Re.
Our employees are our greatest strength. That's why we offer them a wide range of benefits. You can find some examples below.
Unlock your potential

- Diversity, Equity & Inclusion: we embrace the power of differences and are convinced that diversity fosters innovation and resilience and enables us to act braver and better.
- Continuous Learning: we believe that continuous learning is a key differentiator and critical for building new skills and accelerating growth.
- Career Mobility: we actively support career mobility, and our strong global and regional presence offers a wealth of career growth opportunities for you.

Rewards & Recognition

- Competitive salary: appropriate compensation for your high level of commitment.
- Retirement provision: state of the art in-house pension solutions.
- Work-life balance: promoting the compatibility of family and work in addition to overall work-life balance.
- Health management: focus on your physical and mental health far beyond legal requirements.
- Hybrid working: living the best of both worlds - we offer you a very flexible approach as well as the opportunity to work from abroad on an occasional basis.
- Munich Re not only stands for fairness with regard to its clients; it is also an equal opportunities employer. Severely disabled candidates will also be prioritized, if equally qualified.

jobs.occupation: Working Student (d/f/m) in the area of Mass Properties (Ingenieur/in - Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik)
jobs.description:
About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

In order to support Mass Properties department, Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a

Working Student (d/f/m) in the area of Mass Properties

You are a full time student, looking for a working student position and want to get to know the work of a Working Student (d/f/m) in the area of Mass Properties?  Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us in the Mass Properties department as a working student (d/f/m) with approx. 18 hours a week!

- Location: Manching
- Start: January 2027
- Duration: 12 months

Definition working student

Working students (d/f/m) are students who are enrolled at a University or some other institution of higher education, and who are employed in a reasonably long, fixed-term position parallel to their studies. This position must not be confused with an internship or with the possibility of writing a final thesis.

This employment usually takes place directly on the company's premises. A working student's main focus remains on their studies, which is why, during term-time, working students are not allowed to work more than 20 hours per week.

Working students therefore usually work near their place of study, so as to conveniently combine studying and employment.

Your location

Located about an hour’s drive north of Munich, Manching is an up-and-coming market town that offers a wide range of leisure and cultural activities. Here, you can enjoy the quality of life in the countryside while the pleasures of near-by cities are still within easy reach.

Our mission

Mass Properties Manching is responsible for defining, calculating, and controlling the mass data set throughout the entire life‑cycle of an aircraft. This data set includes mass, centre of gravity and moment of inertia at component, system and aircraft levels. It is required, for example, for the preliminary design of future projects, structural design, system development, support of flight‑test campaigns, and in‑service support. Consequently, the department maintains interfaces with a variety of disciplines, both within and outside the Flight Physics domain. To keep the growing mass properties data set organised and to trace every change throughout the development of our new projects, we are building a Python‑driven, SQLite‑backed database application. In parallel, we are exploring how AI‑based automation can further increase the efficiency and accuracy of our analyses.

Your benefits

- Attractive salary and work-life balance with an 18-hour week (flexitime).
- A final thesis is possible after consultation with the department.
- Mobile working after agreement with the department.
- International environment with the opportunity to network globally.
- Work with modern/diversified technologies.
- Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Python Software Development: Develop, maintain, and improve Python-based applications and reusable software components for managing aircraft mass data.
- Database Management: Support the design and implementation of database structures, queries, and data models using relational databases.
- Workflow Automation: Identify and automate repetitive engineering workflows and data-processing tasks to increase efficiency.
- Data Integration & Processing: Develop tools for importing, validating, transforming, and integrating data from various engineering sources and tools.
- AI Research & Prototyping: Investigate and evaluate the application of AI and Large Language Models (LLMs) by developing prototypes for engineering workflows.
- Software Quality Assurance: Ensure software reliability by developing automated/manual test cases, documenting bugs, and improving code maintainability.

Desired skills and qualifications

- Enrolled full-time student (d/f/m) in Computer Science, Data Science, Informatics, Software Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
- Good programming skills in Python and a strong interest in software development.
- Basic knowledge or a strong interest in the following areas: SQL and relational databases (e.g., SQLite, MySQL, PostgreSQL), Software architecture and Object-Oriented Programming, Data processing, automation, and software testing.
- Interest in learning and working with technologies such as: PyQt for GUI development, Git for version control, Jira and Confluence for project management, AI and Large Language Models (LLMs).
- Ability to translate complex engineering problems into structured software solutions through a self-organized and analytical way of working.
- Advanced English; German is a plus.

Please upload the following documents: cover letter, CV, relevant transcripts, enrollment certificate.

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth.

Take your career to a new level and apply online (https://www.airbus.com/en/careers) now!
